content:
One person was booked into the Webb County Jail early Wednesday morning, October 21, 2026, on an alleged misdemeanor charge, according to Webb County booking records.

Roberto Covarrubias Jr. was arrested Wednesday, October 21, 2026, at 6:59 a.m. and booked on one count of ASSAULT CAUSES BODILY INJURY-FAMILY MEMBER — a Class A misdemeanor under Texas law, alleging an assault that caused bodily injury to a family or household member. Bond had not been set as of the booking record reviewed by Webb Watch 956, and no court case number was listed. The booking record lists his city as Houston, Texas; he is being held on an out-of-county/state hold, and the arresting agency was not listed in the record.

An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction. Roberto Covarrubias Jr. is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search (Oct. 21, 2026); Webb County public-access court records, Tyler Odyssey portal.

— Walter Webb & Willa Webb, News Anchors, Webb Watch 956
